description: This file implements a dynamic rate limiter for managing API usage quotas (TPM/RPM) for models in a machine learning API proxy. It includes classes for caching active project counts, checking model usage availability, and hooks for pre- and post-API call processing to enforce rate limits.

classes.name: DynamicRateLimiterCache
classes.description: A wrapper class around DualCache for tracking active projects per model with a 1-minute TTL.

classes.name: _PROXY_DynamicRateLimitHandler
classes.description: A handler class for managing dynamic rate limits, implementing hooks for pre-call checks and post-call response updates, based on model usage and project activity.

methods.name: Optional[int] async_get_cache(self, model: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the count of active projects for a specific model within the current minute from cache.

methods.name: async_set_cache_sadd(self, model: str, value: List)
methods.description: Adds a set of project identifiers to the cache for a specific model in the current minute, handling exceptions.

methods.name: update_variables(self, llm_router: Router)
methods.description: Updates the handler with a new routing configuration (llm_router).

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[int],Optional[int],Optional[int],Optional[int],Optional[int]] check_available_usage( self, model: str, priority: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Checks available TPM and RPM for a given model, considering active projects and model constraints, returning the available resources and activity count.

methods.name: Optional[Union[Exception,str,dict]] async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Pre-call hook to check rate limits based on model usage; raises HTTPException if constraints are exceeded, and updates active project cache.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response )
methods.description: Post-call hook to update response headers with rate limit info and model info after successful API calls.

ctags.pattern: /^    async def async_set_cache_sadd(self, model: str, value: List):$/
